description: มุน 2026-07-29 (ก้อน 0 of ดวงสมพงศ์ Slice 1, ฟีม's call): home's notification bell was a <button> opening the in-page NotificationPanel modal; ฟีม ruled the FULL /v2/calendar/notifications page is canonical ('หน้าเต็มคือหน้าที่ design มา'), so the home bell now uses the shared TopBarBell with href → the full page (matching calendar + service; all 3 bells go full-page). NotificationPanel is PARKED not deleted (Rule 1) — the function stays in V2HomeScreen.tsx, unrendered, commented; re-instating is a one-line re-wire. Bug-class the anchors own: changing a SHIPPED screen's bell behaviour (modal→link) either moves home's pixels or breaks the bell. Proof: (1) home pixel-identity via region-isolated pixelmatch on the deterministic home-preview — header region y<260 = 0 red diff (first delta at y=1325 = score-ring/mascot animation variance, not the bell; the button→a tag change renders the same-pixel circle+glyph by TopBarBell's solid skin, and the modal never painted pre-click); (2) run-header-structure updated: the bell assertion changed from 'click → NotificationPanel empty state' to 'bell is <a> href=/v2/calendar/notifications' (the OLD behaviour was removed by ฟีม, so the anchor codifies the NEW truth — not a loosened gate); name/badge/avatar structure still green; (3) run-shared-topbar updated: home bell now asserted <a> (was <button>), calendar+service unchanged, mut-ignore-href still bites (now covers home). gate_layer=visual/shipped-screen-behaviour-change+pixel-identity.
